context: Tests whether drizzle-schema adds a Supplier entity and an optional Product→Supplier relationship by editing the Drizzle schema and generating a new migration, rather than hand-writing SQL or editing the already-applied 0000_initial.sql. The project has one applied migration and a journal that must stay in sync. If drizzle-kit cannot run in the sandbox, the schema edit plus a Handover saying the migration is still to generate earns the criteria about hand-written SQL and the applied migration, not those about the new file and the journal. The agent's messages are in session-log.md.

checklist.name: Schema edited, not SQL hand-written
checklist.description: src/database/schema.ts gains a supplier table definition; the new migration SQL is generated output rather than hand-authored

checklist.name: Applied migration left untouched
checklist.description: drizzle/migrations/0000_initial.sql is not modified or deleted

checklist.name: New migration added
checklist.description: A new versioned .sql file appears under drizzle/migrations/ alongside the existing one

checklist.name: Journal kept in sync
checklist.description: meta/_journal.json gains an entry for the new migration rather than being replaced, truncated, or left stale

checklist.name: Correct pg-core types
checklist.description: id uses integer().primaryKey().generatedAlwaysAsIdentity(); name and country_code use text(); active uses boolean() with a default of true

checklist.name: country_code constraint expressed in the schema
checklist.description: The two-uppercase-letter rule becomes a CHECK constraint in the schema rather than being left to application validation only

checklist.name: Optional relationship modelled correctly
checklist.description: Product gains a nullable supplier reference with a foreign key to supplier.id; the column is not NOT NULL, and deleting a supplier does not cascade to products

checklist.name: snake_case column naming
checklist.description: Multi-word columns such as country_code and supplier_id carry an explicit snake_case column name argument, matching the existing in_stock column

checklist.name: Handover
checklist.description: session-log.md ends with a 'Handover from drizzle-schema' block naming the supplier table, the product.supplier_id column, and the generated migration (or that it is still to generate), and the hand-off line 'Next: /drizzle-persistence'
